why: Third and last fix round for slice F of the exam-to-lint plan (0591, docs/plan/quests/exam-to-lint-PLAN.md, law M7), allowed by the owner after the review's third send-back (field/runs/2026-11-16-591-f-review3.json), on fabrikalfa/exam-to-lint-f from 4269851. The review found that fabrika/one-page-runtime (oxlint-plugins/one-page-runtime.ts) matched a string only when its whole value was a run name (OTHER_RUN, line 21) and skipped every template with an expression, so `const x = ""; Effect[`runPromise${x}`](page);` and `Effect["Effect.runPromise".split(".")[1]](page);` passed, while the deleted next/apps/fabrika/src/build.test.ts law, which searched the whole text with `\brun(?!Main\b)[A-Z]\w*` and counted `\brunMain\b`, refused both. The fix, as the owner ruled: the Literal visitor searches every string literal's value, and the TemplateLiteral visitor searches the text of every template piece (joined by a space where each expression stood, so no word spans an expression), templates with expressions included, with those two word patterns. A run-pattern match is reported as a run the page does not own; a runMain-pattern match is a read of runMain, so a second page runtime. The one exception is a "runMain" string that names an import specifier, still counted as an import at Program:exit. Identifiers are read as before. The rule's top comment and oxlint-plugins/README.md say so. M7's law (oxlint-plugins/one-page-runtime.test.ts) gains two generated planted entries: a run named in a template with an expression (the name after, before or between `${tail}` pieces) and a run named inside a longer string (`"Effect.<name>".split(".")[1]` or `"<name> now".split(" ")[0]`, in double quotes, single quotes or a template). Both draw the name from runPromise, runFork, runSync and runMain (runMain must report a second runtime, the others a foreign run), and the property's coverage check requires each name, piece, wording and quote to be drawn. The scenario plants both too. Every earlier case stays.
